verdict.rationale: The pack contains no published tokens-per-second or latency figures, no benchmarks, and no load-testing guides from DeepInfra. The docs only make qualitative speed statements, such as priority requests getting "faster time-to-first-token". The one number present (cold-start under 10s) comes from a community comment, not a provider publication, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims
